Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Anastasia of Serbia’s husband as Stefan Prvovenčani (her son) despite the initial search result clearly showing her husband was Stefan Nemanja. This led all subsequent searches to target the wrong individual and never address the correct place of death.
